This '''settlement''' was located on a [[Unidentified planet (Wilds)|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The settlement was seventeen [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from the [[Wilds (corvaj)|Wilds]], an area of swamps and jungles. When [[Ranna Gorjaye]] crash-landed in the Wilds, she set off for the settlement.
